arabic text: BABA, MERE BABA
english translation text: BABA, O MY BABA

arabic text: SHAH KI LAADLI JAB QAIDI-E-ZINDAAN HUI
english translation text: WHEN THE BELOVED DAUGHTER OF THE KING BECAME A PRISONER IN THE PRISON

arabic text: ROI GHABRAAYI BAHUT, AUR PARESHAAN HUI
english translation text: SHE WAS VERY AFRAID, AND SHE CRIED A LOT, AND SHE WAS VERY TROUBLED (BY THE ENEMIES)

arabic text: QAID KHAANE KI GHUTAN, MAWT KA SAMAAN HUI
english translation text: (TO THE EXTENT THAT) THE SUFFOCATION OF THE PRISON BECAME HER LUGGAGE FOR THE JOURNEY AHEAD

arabic text: JAAN LAGTA THA KE MA’ṢUM KI BE-JAAN HUI
english translation text: IT WAS AS IF THE LIFE OF THE MA’ṢUM BECAME LIFELESS

arabic text: LAASH SHABBIR KI MAQTAL MEIN TADAP JAATI THI
english translation text: THE BODY OF SHABBIR WOULD WINCE IN THE MAQTAL

arabic text: QAID KHAANE SE JO, BACCHI KI SADAA AATI THI
english translation text: WHEN HE WOULD HEAR THE PAINFUL CRIES OF THE LITTLE GIRL FROM THE PRISON, SAYING…

arabic text: AB MUJHE KOI SAKINA NAHIN KEHTA BABA
english translation text: O BABA, NO ONE CALLS ME SAKINA ANYMORE

arabic text: QAIDI KEHTA HAI KOI, KOI YATEEMA BABA
english translation text: SOMEONE REFERS TO ME AS A PRISONER, WHILE OTHERS REFER TO ME AS AN ORPHAN.

arabic text: NEEL RUKHSARON PE BINAAYI BHI JISKI KAM HO
english translation text: MY CHEEKS HAVE TURNED BLUE FROM THE SLAPS AND MY VISION HAS BECOME BLURRED

arabic text: UMR HO CHAAR BARAS AUR KAMAR MEIN KHAM HO
english translation text: I AM FOUR YEARS OLD, BUT MY BACK IS BROKEN

arabic text: AAPNE DEKHI HAI KYA AISI ZAIFAA BABA
english translation text: HAVE YOU EVER SEEN AN AGED GIRL LIKE ME O BABA?

arabic text: MAIN BAYAAN KAISE KAROON APNI MUSEEBAT TUMSE
english translation text: HOW DO I NARRATE TO YOU MY TRAGEDY?

arabic text: KYA KAROON APNE TAMAACHO(N) KI SHIKAYAT TUMSE
english translation text: HOW DO I COMPLAIN TO YOU ABOUT THE SLAPS THAT I ENDURED?

arabic text: SUNTI HOON DAADI NE KHAAYA THA TAMAACHA BABA
english translation text: WHEN I’VE HEARD THAT MY GRANDMOTHER (FAṬIMAH AL-ZAHRA` (SA)) WAS SLAPPED AS WELL!

arabic text: KHOON-E-BE-SHEER SE ANDAAZA KIYA THA MAINE
english translation text: SEEING THE BLOOD OF THE BE-SHEER (ONE WHO DID NOT GET ANY MILK) I PERCEIVED WHAT HAD HAPPENED

arabic text: AAPKA CHEHRA TOH PEHCHAAN LIYA THA MAINE
english translation text: I HAD SEEN THE ENTIRE TRAGEDY BY THE LOOK ON YOUR FACE THAT DAY

arabic text: AAP PEHCHAANO(N)GE KAISE MERA CHEHRA BABA
english translation text: O BABA, HOW WILL YOU BE ABLE TO RECOGNIZE MY FACE NOW?

arabic text: AAP THE DOOR TOH MAIN SAARE SITAM SEHTI RAHI
english translation text: WHILE YOU WERE AWAY, I ENDURED ALL THE AFFLICTIONS AND OPPRESSIONS UPON ME

arabic text: RO PADI KUFE KE DARBAAR MEIN, MAIN SEH NAA SAKI
english translation text: BUT IN THE COURT IN KUFAH, I COULD NO LONGER BARE WHEN...

arabic text: AAPKE SAAMNE JAB SHIMR NE MARA BABA
english translation text: SHIMR HIT ME IN FRONT OF YOU, O BABA!

arabic text: WOH TOH BIMAAR THI, MAR JAATI, SAFAR MEIN AAKE
english translation text: SHE WAS VERY SICK, SHE WOULD’VE DIED IF SHE CAME ON THIS TRIP WITH US

arabic text: DAFAN KARTE USE BAZAAR MEIN, BHAIYYA KAISE?
english translation text: HOW WOULD MY BROTHER HAVE SHROUDED HER IN THE MIDDLE OF THE MARKET?

arabic text: YEH TOH ACCHA HUWA AAYI NAHIN SUGHRA BABA
english translation text: SO IT IS GOOD THAT SUGHRA DID NOT ACCOMPANY US ON THIS TRIP, O BABA.

arabic text: MERI AANKHON SE BAHE JAATE THE AANSOON USS DAM
english translation text: THE TEARS WOULD NOT STOP FLOWING DOWN MY EYES IN THAT MOMENT

arabic text: HAATH BHI MAINE LAGAYA NAHIN, DAADI KI QASAM
english translation text: BUT I DID NOT EXTEND MY HAND, I SWEAR ON MY GRANDMOTHER

arabic text: DENA CHAHA THA MUJHE, LOGON NE SADAQAH BABA
english translation text: WHEN THE PEOPLE TRIED TO EVEN GIVE ME THEIR SADAQA, O BABA!

arabic text: USS GHADI DHOOND RAHI THI MAIN, CHACHA JAAN KA SAR
english translation text: IN THAT MOMENT I WAS SEARCHING FOR THE HEAD OF MY BELOVED UNCLE (‘ABBAS (AS))

arabic text: KAISE BATLAOON KE KYA GUZRI TERI BETI PAR
english translation text: HOW DO I EXPLAIN TO YOU WHAT YOUR DAUGHTER HAS ENDURED?

arabic text: HAYE MUJHKO ZAALIM NE KANIZI MEIN JO MARA BABA
english translation text: WHEN THE OPPRESSOR HIT ME IN THE MOMENT OF MY SERVITUDE

arabic text: BAYN YEH KARTE HI KHAMOSH HUI WOH AKBAR
english translation text: O AKBAR (THE POET), ONCE SHE NARRATED ALL OF THIS TO HER FATHER SHE BECAME QUIET:

arabic text: AAJ TOH JAYENGE SAATH APNE MUJHE BHI LEKAR
english translation text: TODAY, I KNOW HE WILL TAKE ME WITH HIM

arabic text: AAPKO MERI QASAM, KIJIYE WAADA BABA
english translation text: FOR MY SAKE, PROMISE ME YOU WILL O BABA!
